The '''Mid-Season Invitational''' (commonly referred to as ''MSI'') is the first cross-regional competition of the annual LoL Esports calendar. It features twelve teams, the winning teams from eight individual Riot Leagues Spring Splits and the runners-up from three ([[LCK/2024/Spring|LCK]], [[LPL/2024/Spring|LPL]], and [[LCS/2024/Spring|LCS]].) In addition the winner from the [[LEC/2024/Winter|LEC Winter]] split is also qualified to the play-in stage. MSI 2024 is held in Chengdu, China at the Wuliangye Chengdu Performing Arts Center. The event runs between May 1<sup>st</sup> and 19<sup>th</sup>. 

A new rule for 2024 is that the MSI champion will now earn direct qualification to the [[World_Championship/2024|2024 World Championship]], guaranteeing an additional slot for its region. This rule will only apply if the winning team reaches the Playoffs in their domestic Summer split.

Additionally, the second best region in the final standings will also be granted an additional seed for its domestic league at Worlds. <ref>{{cite web |url=https://lolesports.com/article/the-state-of-the-game-lol-esports-in-2024/blt2d30ff1e12862524 |title=The State of the Game: LoL Esports in 2024|date=2024-01-04 |publisher=LoL Esports|language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>

==Format==
* '''Qualification'''
** Twelve teams from professional leagues will qualify for the event.
** The [[LPL]], [[LCK]], [[LEC]], and [[LCS]] will have 2 slots, the [[LLA]], [[CBLOL]], [[PCS]] and [[VCS]] have one slot. <ref name="2024 Format Venue">{{cite web |url=https://lolesports.com/article/msi-2024-format,-venue,-ticket-information/bltf0f6812a20dc5ba5 |title=MSI 2024 Format, Venue, Ticket Information|date=2024-03-29|publisher=[[LoL Esports]] |language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>
*** Following the merger of the [[LJL]] into the [[PCS]] Ecosystem this year, they no longer have a direct slot at MSI, but are able to qualify through the [[PCS/2024/Spring|PCS Playoffs]] similiar to the [[LCO]] teams. <ref name="ljl merged with lco">{{cite web |url=https://lolesports.com/article/league-of-legends-japan-league-joins-pacific-championship-series-ecosystem/blt80ae84082260adc9 |title=League of Legends Japan League Joins Pacific Championship Series Ecosystem |date=2023-12-23 |author=[[LJL]] |publisher=[[LoL Esports]] |language={{Flag|us}} us}}</ref>

* '''Play-In Stage''' - ''May 1<sup>st</sup> – 5<sup>th</sup>''
** Eight teams are divided into two groups where they play a Double Elimination Bracket. (Also often known as a ''[[starcraft2:Dual_Tournament_Format|GSL-Style Group stage]]'')
** All matches are played in a {{Abbr/Bo3}}.
** {{Bgcolortext|up|Top 2 teams}} in each group advance to Bracket Stage.
** {{Bgcolortext|down|Bottom 2 teams}} in each group are eliminated.
** '''Side Selection Procedures'''
*** In the first round, first game side selection is reserved for the Pool 1/2 team;
*** In subsequent rounds, first game side selection will be decided by a coin toss (or equivalent procedure);
*** For all series, apart from the first game, the side selection for subsequent games will be decided by the loser of the previous game.

* '''Bracket Stage''' - ''May 7<sup>nd</sup> - 12<sup>th</sup>, and May 14<sup>th</sup> - 19<sup>th</sup>''
** Eight teams play in a Double Elimination Bracket.
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}.
** '''Side Selection Procedures'''
*** In the first round, first game side selection is reserved for team who started in the Bracket Stage;
*** In the grand finals, first game side selection is reserved for the winner of the Upper Bracket finals;
*** In all other rounds, first game side selection will be decided by a coin toss (or equivalent procedure);
*** For all series, apart from the first game, the side selection for subsequent games will be decided by the loser of the previous game.

* '''Patch Information'''
** {{ChampionIcon|Skarner|20px}} [[Skarner]] is disabled for this tournament due to the ''"New Champions and VGUs must be enabled for playoffs in all four of the top regions in order to be playable at the next international tournament."'' policy.<!--<ref name="yuumi banned">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/lolesports/status/1648748727765549056|title=A quick update regarding champion restrictions for #MSI2023|author=LoL Esports|publisher=Twitter|date=2023-04-19|language={{Flag|usuk}}English}}</ref>-->

===MSI 2024 Draw Show===
* The MSI Draw Show will be held after [[LPL/2024/Spring/Playoffs|LPL Spring Finals]] to place teams into groups for the Play-In Stage of the Mid-Season Invitational 2024.<ref name="#Worlds2023 Play-In Stage Draw Show">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/lolesports/status/1778446360980684995|title=Tune in for the #MSI2024 Draw Show during the #LPL Spring Finals on April 20th, featuring special guest Xiye!|author=LoL Esports|date=2024-04-11|language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>
** ''[https://www.youtube.com/live/H-WZvO2ZJ5M?feature=shared&t=19000 Click here to watch the Play-In Draw Show video] Hosted by {{player|Iris|link=Xiran|flag=cn}} and guested by {{player|Xiye|flag=cn}}''
** <span class="mw-customtoggle-Playin-Draw" style="border-bottom:1px dotted;">''Click here for detailed information about MSI Draw Show''</span>
<div class="toccolours mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" id="mw-customcollapsible-Playin-Draw" style="margin-top:10px;">
* Teams are splited into 4 seed pools to ensure quality groups.
** 8 teams are splited into 4 pools
*** '''Pool 1''' will consist of LPL2 (''TES''), LCK2 (''T1'').
*** '''Pool 2''' will consist of LEC2 (''FNC''), LCS2 (''FLY'').
*** '''Pool 3''' will consist of PCS1 (''PSG''), VCS1 (''GAM'').
*** '''Pool 4''' will consist of LLA1 (''EST''), CBLOL (''LLL'').
* One team from each Pool will be seeded to each group.
* Pool 1 teams will face Pool 4 teams, while Pool 2 teams will face Pool 3 teams in the first round.
</div>
*Bracket Stage Draw Show will be held after the completion of the Play-in.
** ''[https://www.youtube.com/live/H-WZvO2ZJ5M?feature=shared&t=19000 Click here to watch the Bracket Stage Draw Show video] Hosted by {{player|Hilda|flag=cn}} and guested by {{player|Xiye|flag=cn}}''
** <span class="mw-customtoggle-Swiss-Draw" style="border-bottom:1px dotted;">''Click here for detailed information about Bracket Stage Draw show''</span>
<div class="toccolours mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" id="mw-customcollapsible-Swiss-Draw" style="margin-top:10px;">
* Teams are splited into 4 seed pools to ensure quality groups.
** 8 teams are splited into 4 pools
*** '''Pool 1''' will consist of LPL1 (''BLG''), LCK1 (''GEN'')
*** '''Pool 2''' will consist of LEC1 (''G2''), and LCS1 (''TL'').
*** '''Pool 3''' will consist of the 2 teams who went 2-0 in the Play-in (''T1'' and ''TES'').
*** '''Pool 4''' will consist of the 2 teams who went 2-1 in the Play-in (''PSG'' and ''FNC'').
* Pool 1 teams will face Pool 4 teams, while Pool 2 teams will face Pool 3 teams in the first round.
* Each region can only have one team in each half of the upper bracket.
</div>

==Trivia==
* [[G2 Esports]] and [[T1]] return to this year's MSI with the same rosters as in [[Mid-Season_Invitational/2023|MSI 2023]]. In T1's case, this is the first time an organisation plays in the MSI for 3 consecutive years with the same roster (since [[Mid-Season_Invitational/2022|MSI 2022]]).
* The winner from [[Mid-Season_Invitational/2023|last year's MSI]], [[JD Gaming]], won't return to defend the title, as they failed to qualify after losing to [[Top Esports]] in the Lower Bracket Final in the [[LPL/2024/Spring|LPL 2024 Spring Playoffs]].
* {{player|Bin|pos=top|flag=cn}} is the first player from LPL to play in 3 consecutive MSI.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://weibo.com/6931173462/O9h8r5SXF|title=Bin成为LPL首个连续三年进入MSI的选手|trans_title=Bin becomes LPL's first player to play in 3 consecutive MSI|date=2024-04-11|language={{Flag|cn}} Chinese}}</ref>
